name: Telegram
one_liner: Telegram Bot API (HTTPS, bot token via @BotFather) is the intended integration surface; MTProto client API and Gateway API are separate products.
auth_notes: Bot API: unique bot token issued by @BotFather, placed in the URL. MTProto: api_id/api_hash plus user login. Gateway API: Bearer token.
access_notes: Bots are created free via @BotFather. Optional paid broadcasts cost 0.1 Stars per message above 30/s. No app review.

buildability.rationale: Bot API is free, self-serve, documented, with setWebhook and getUpdates. Bots cannot read user chats; MTProto user-account use is a different, riskier path.

needs_human_reason: Ambiguity resolved to Bot API; confirm product wants bot, not user-account, semantics.

auth.quote: Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created

api_surface.quote: bots are not able to broadcast more than about 30 messages per second, unless they enable paid broadcasts

identity.quote: The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.

disputes.why: Bot API token is bot-specific, placed in URL path, not a Bearer header; Bearer applies only to Gateway.
Bot API is HTTP-based with JSON methods.
Bot API reference (v10.5) lists well over 100 methods; count not verified.
FAQ documents 30 msg/s broadcast and 20 msg/min group limits.
Bot API reference and token details were fetched; ambiguity resolved.
